en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a stone terrace or memorial with steps leading up to a central bronze statue of a man in military-style dress standing beside a dog. Behind the statue is a curved balustrade and a stone wall featuring three portrait reliefs and a planter with flowers. Trees and a wooded hillside are visible in the background. Printed German captions appear at the top.
